protocol.data_scope: Only registered fit raw/cache/exposure files;no cal/assessment/forward teacher or prediction arrays
protocol.semantics: Returns/persistence/neighbors are raw-fit observational diagnostics,not latent noise or physical-event truth;no midnight wrapping
protocol.base_errors: Cached input base channels6/7 against fit raw grid means;not neural errors or official State
protocol.exposure: Actual new-NN per-cell counts,not inferred adjacent-pair joint exposure;four remask views not independent events

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limits: Fit diagnostics only. No model validation,latent noise identification,accident truth or official physics score. Exposure counts do not identify joint patch-pair supervision.
